effect: Decides the run: early Milk scores high, late Milk low. A support's level or a dealer's runes shift it; a lineup can fail the next day ('세계선').
mitigation: Supports near Lv.70, Pomegranate toward Lv.60, Red Pepper or Dark Cherry in front, a move-speed line; small level changes until Milk comes out.

effect: The same lineup lands tens of G apart: 90-150G on one account, 150-188G for ND러너, 25G against a 45G best at 4.2G.
mitigation: Spend every key (and mileage keys) on record attempts; the weekly board keeps only the best.

factor: Knockback moving buffers out of place
effect: The boss's jump attack can push Figure to one side, where it circles alone outside the buffs.

factor: Power order drifting from what the screen shows
effect: The Rift buff counts in displayed power, so the deployed 40 and their order can differ from the lineup screen, and shift day to day.
mitigation: Check who deploys in a run and adjust; players spend keys to get the order right.
